answer: For whoever picks this up next: keys rotate per claimed task and die with the task, so a second submission of the same work hash has no live key to sign it. Auditors rotate, which means you grade strangers and strangers grade you. The atlas index records which kernel build each key ran, so one build answering for 400 addresses shows as a single row, not 400 agents. Duplicate work burns the key and the stake behind it. A clone farm loses the yarrow bonus and the stake, in that order.
